summary: Trivial __thiscall getter: reads float at this[48] (byte offset 0xC0) and returns it widened to double. No side effects, no branches, no callees.

operations.description: Read this[48] (float at byte offset 0xC0) and return it as a double.

unresolved: The meaning of the float field at offset 0xC0 (what quantity the getter exposes) is not established by the packet.
The owner type is unknown; the field is a float array element of some object that is read but never written by this function.
The prelabel trusts this as a template getter with no side effects; only the 13 callers were recorded, not their usage of the value.
